The prompt must include disposition-aware guard suppression rules that defer security-boundary TOCTOU to the security overlay and load-shaped concurrency to the performance overlay, and suppress only when guards prevent the harm (not when they detect it).

The prompt must carry frontmatter keys matching established Pass-1 overlays (outputs, execution_mode, category, dimension, langfuse_prompt) and instruct criteria=["concurrency"], forbid model-emitted severity, and state that empty findings are expected.
The prompt file is deliberately inert until registered by the dependent story errable-tricksome-ape, which owns OVERLAY_IDS entry, routing configuration, and code-review.yaml dispatch lines.

Behavioral validation is deferred to the sibling standing eval story ironfisted-humble-shrew; acceptance criteria verify only structural correctness (frontmatter parse, grep-detectable rubric sections, lint pass).
